mapper.select: SELECT r.role_code FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1
SELECT id,role_code,role_name,description,status,create_time FROM sys_role ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT id,role_code,role_name,description,status,create_time FROM sys_role WHERE role_code = #{roleCode} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_role (role_code, role_name, description, status, create_time) VALUES (#{roleCode}, #{roleName}, #{description}, #{status}, NOW())
INSERT INTO sys_role_menu (role_id, menu_id, create_time) VALUES (#{roleId}, #{menuId}, NOW())
